name: System-State Matrix
description: Observed condition of multiple systems across dimensions. Infrastructure status, asset state and configuration review.
reference_use_case: Infrastructure status, asset state and configuration review.
integrity_rule: Observed, desired and inferred states must remain separate.
antipattern: Do not confuse observed conditions, desired configuration and inferred health.
design_question: Which measurements and observation times form each state snapshot?
situational_schema: Systems are measured on comparable dimensions at stated times, distinct from target configuration.
